name: conversion-copywriting-psychology
description: Provides behavioral psychology, cognitive bias application, conversion copywriting formulas, value proposition messaging, and customer awareness stage mapping based on Daniel Kahneman (Thinking, Fast and Slow), Robert Cialdini (Influence), and Eugene Schwartz (Breakthrough Advertising). Use when authoring landing page copy, value propositions, call-to-action microcopy, cold outreach sequences, or evaluating objection-handling messaging.
